svg.aria-label: RMSNorm versus LayerNorm: response to additive input shift
svg.title: RMSNorm versus LayerNorm: response to additive input shift
svg.desc: An illustrative two-feature input (1+b, 3+b) is shifted by b from zero to two and back. Input bars change. RMSNorm output changes since it does not subtract the mean. LayerNorm always produces (-1, 1) in this idealised epsilon-zero, unit-gain comparison. Axes are individually scaled and this is not benchmark data.
